_note: Hand-stated relationships. This file is deliberately tiny. Almost every edge in the graph is derived — shared citations, chronology by sequence number, theme membership by keyword frequency — and derived edges are traceable back to the layer that produced them. What lands here is only what the corpus states in prose and no amount of citation-matching would find: family. Each entry names where the relationship is stated. Prophet and seerah ordering is NOT here; the builder derives it from sequence_number.

edges.note: His firstborn, and the son of the sacrifice.

edges.note: The son promised to him and Sarah in old age.
edges.source: Qur'an 14:39; and 11:71 — the glad tidings of Ishaq.

edges.note: Yaqub, also called Israel, from whom the twelve tribes descend.
